args.body: Hi Dora, I visited your website www.dora-website.com and I think it's great! The design is clean and professional. However, I noticed that the website could benefit from more interactive elements to engage visitors. Consider adding a blog section or project showcases to make it more dynamic. Also, ensure that the contact information is easily accessible. Overall, a solid personal website with room for growth!

Hi Eve, I visited your blog www.eve-blog.com and I love your passion for hiking! The blog is simple and clean. Consider adding more frequent posts, categories for different hikes, and maybe some photos or videos to make it more engaging. Also, an about page would help readers get to know you better. Great start!
